clips.title: Shifted Passage
clips.prompt: The nearest partition shifts slightly and redirects the open passage. Viewpoint: The viewpoint makes one small restrained adjustment. Use at most one small viewpoint movement. Animate only subjects and objects already visible in the start frame.
